burstResolve.label: Resolve at 60 stacks
burstResolve.reason: Resolve stacks come from the Energy her team spends, so how many she holds depends on the team. Checked once with it on against Genshin Optimizer.

skillEye.label: Eye of Stormy Judgment
skillEye.reason: Her Elemental Skill is always cast before her Burst, and its Eye stays up through the Burst, so the Burst DMG bonus is on whenever her Burst hits.
